_metadata.description: Scenario delta overrides for NVIDIA DCF model. Each scenario ONLY contains keys that differ from base assumptions. Apply via deep_merge(base_assumptions, scenario_overrides). Never use shallow dict.update() because nested keys must merge recursively.
_metadata.principle: Scenarios never mutate base. Base remains untouched. Switching scenario changes only the overridden keys.
_metadata.changelog: v1.2 - rewrote scenario overrides so all key paths match assumptions.json exactly: wacc, dcf, and nested revenue_growth.

base._comment: Base case is intentionally empty - all values live in assumptions.json. This is the canonical reference.

upside._comment: Bull case: AI acceleration continues and discount rate/tgr shift favorably.

downside._comment: Bear case: AI spending slowdown and discount rate/tgr shift unfavorably.

_usage_example.note: MUST use deep_merge (recursive) - NOT shallow dict.update(). Shallow update replaces entire sub-dicts instead of merging individual nested keys.
_usage_example.wacc_override_pattern: WACC is overridden at wacc.wacc. After deep_merge, final_assumptions['wacc']['wacc'] == 0.1191 for upside.
